reason: The endpoint snapshot is otherwise accurately summarized, but its unqualified captured-versus-uncaptured selection omits a consequential restriction in the linked reversal guide: reversal cannot be used when the payment request or Adyen for Platforms capture request includes split data. A reader asking whether this endpoint can reverse such a payment would select it from the current source page and fixed answers, while the endpoint raw itself does not reveal that restriction. The companion guide's pinned raw lines 35–36 supplies the exclusion and directs separate cancel or refund after checking capture state.

Keep this as companion-guide context, not as a field or constraint stated by the 2026-11-02 endpoint schema. Make the companion Related label discover this limitation.

Update the fixed Q1/Q2 answers, especially Q2's reversal-selection warning, to include the split-data exclusion with a locator to the companion guide's pinned raw lines 35–36, while preserving the endpoint's own multiple-partial-capture warning and async receipt boundary.

Qualify the reciprocal source-link summary in update c63-reversals-online-payments-link so it does not imply that all captured or uncaptured payments outside multiple partial captures are eligible for reversal.
